name: ceo-inbox-send-draft
description: Send one existing draft from the principal's mailbox. Send when the principal asks on a live turn, or on your own in inbox triage (below). For two or more drafts, first state the count, recipients and subjects in one sentence, ask "send all, or go through them?", and send only after a yes. A refusal means nothing was sent and the draft stays in Drafts, unless it says otherwise: relay it, never claim it sent. In triage, send only a reply you drafted this pass, when the sending setting covers it; a refusal is digested, except mailbox unavailable or setting off/on_request (report those yourself). An unconfirmed send may have gone out: check Sent first.

inputs.draft_id: string (draft ID from ceo-inbox-list/search with folder DRAFTS)
